answers.explanation: The expression means using definitions to help people communicate their thoughts and argue logically.
Defining by enumeration is disadvantageous because the examples listed may not be all-inclusive.
The passage summarizes definition as indicating the class of a word with its general property and examples.
The passage says every speaker or writer has some method of fixing the meaning of the words used.
The passage argues for deregulation, setting out its expected benefits.
The passage says Nigerians have not fared better with the economy under government control, so a better life depends on deregulating the economy.
The writer says the fears about deregulation are unfounded, so the anxiety is groundless.
The passage says absence of direct control does not mean the government surrenders its rights, so deregulation does not preclude its influence.
The advocates argue that deregulation will reduce wastage, corruption and inefficiency, including in the NNPC.
The passage says personal writing is more forceful and direct and is more like conversation, so it is more diverting.
The passage says objectivity is best attained by the impersonal style, which the early report writers used.
The passage says most newspaper and magazine writing is impersonal and usually not dull, so it is impersonal and interesting.
The passage says the writer decides the style based on the circumstances of each report situation.
The writer gives balanced views on both styles and leaves the choice to circumstances, so he is non-committal.
Common factors that underlie and account for the facts is the correct phrase.
The controlled experiment is the method described.
All other conditions are kept the same.
Keeping other variables constant is the method.
This method of using controls is the method referred to.
The question asks whether moisture must be present for a bar of iron to rust.
The phrase in one season refers to the growing season.
In the course of his inquiries the scientist finds an explanation.
An explanation that fits the facts is called a hypothesis.
A hypothesis that stands the test of experiments becomes a law.
In spite of any problems means despite them.
Intricate rules are complicated, which fits the difficulty of getting over them.
Show their mettle means show their courage and ability.
The plural analyses takes the plural verb attract.
Clapped its hands and showered encomiums describes praise.
Elected Baba chairman is the correct construction.
A comment that is very amusing is described as ludicrous.
The noun uplift is correct for the improvement of the organization.
He is at Kaduna on an official assignment is the correct preposition pair.
The future is rosy though many seem pessimistic about it.
Guerrillas is the correct spelling.
The quality of your questions has always attracted attention and has never been in doubt.
To come off means to succeed, which fits a wedding that did not take place.
Anyone is the correct indefinite pronoun in a negative question.
Financial support is the correct phrase.
The party looks vulnerable because many members have defected to other parties.
He no longer suffers from loss of memory, which fits the amnesia.
By next year I will have been twenty years old is the correct future perfect form.
The operations of the bank do not cover cottage industries.
The magistrate's words were an insult and a battery.
A good long talk together is the correct order.
To agree to terms is the correct preposition.
On a common footing is the correct phrase.
If one perseveres, he will succeed, with the singular pronoun he.
Riding a motor can be harmful to your health is the correct structure.

World has a different vowel sound from does, son and flood.
Rough has a different vowel sound from cough, rot and dog.
Past has the same t sound as preached.
Eyes has the same z sound as business.
Trophy has the same f sound as cough.
